focus_area_title: Take Advantage of Patient Safety Awareness Week
content_text_body:
###Why is it Important?

Patient Safety Awareness Week is a recognition event held every year, intended to encourage people to learn more about safety in healthcare. During this week, the Institute for Healthcare Improvement seeks to advance important discussions locally and globally, and inspire action to improve the safety of the healthcare system. 

It's also a dedicated time to awareness about patient safety and recognize the work already being done. This is a great week during which to recognize care staff for their commitment and accomplishments related to patient safety. **Below are some examples of recognition you could implement during Patient Safety Awareness week:**

- Publicly shout out specific staff members and committees that work everyday to provide safe care

- Ask departments to develop poster presentations of their successful safety efforts and display them in the hallways

- Highlight your organization-wide safety accomplishments during this time; including how the results of any safety culture surveys you have participated in have improved

- Hold several safety-focused trainings

- Publish safety-focused articles for your internal newsletter, professional newsletters, local newspapers, or local consumer groups

- Contact a local radio station to host a spokesperson from the organization to share patient safety tips and highlights

- Launch a new safety awareness effort: a "good catch" program, a "Comprehensive Unit-based Safety Program Team," etc
 
>Sources:
